scope: counterfactual continuation planning, learned survival-spectrum critic and conservative fusion; no claimed world-first novelty; phase-aware veto arbitration

freshValidation.selection: first nonterminal reachable distinct canonical boards in precommitted seed order; all failures logged; no candidate results used

comparators: exact frozen input V11.6 God HTML
exact frozen V11.5 God stable HTML
acceptance.paired: same board, score, moves, complete PRNG state; real game RNG never supplied to planning
acceptance.noSinglePeakReason: Prespecified before any fresh18001+ corpus or outcomes: at least25%of independent seeds improve, wins>=losses, paired median gain>=0, and dropping any one seed retains>=2%mean gain. A single exceptional game cannot carry default activation. Repeats are clustered by their20independent seeds.

freeze: hash final strategy parameters, source, HTML, and selected candidate before independent terminal tests. If tuned afterwards use new independent corpus.
ablation: planning off; tail guard off; confirmation off, on all eight known starts only
performance: same boards, warm up, alternating A/B, same four compute workers, sequential CPU workloads; planner may cost more and no speed claim without matched-board median/P95 evidence
delivery: separate small runtime/source package and raw evidence package; no historical raw logs duplicated
repeatReason: Counterfactual trajectories are deterministic, but inherited wall-budget verifier/proof paths require repeats; retain both.

learnedCandidate.data: historical V11.7 stable/v116 r0 only; all 28 seeds are known
learnedCandidate.labels: maximum demonstrated remaining lifetime for per-seed canonical duplicate states
learnedCandidate.features: 64 public tile-geometry features; no score, moves, seeds or PRNG inputs
learnedCandidate.model: three cluster-bootstrap conditional-survival MLPs,64-32-3,30 fixed epochs,Adam0.002,batch256,one CPU thread; hierarchical products guarantee monotone survival scores
learnedCandidate.developmentHoldout: known seed clusters modulo5=0 for predictive diagnostics only
learnedCandidate.decisionGate: all three improve normalized survival-area score by>=0.02; 256/1024 heads decrease no more than0.002; worst quarter birth-weighted area decrease no more than0.005; original root gap<=0.003; all birth cells exact 90/10; preserve completed inherited risk and immediate mortality
learnedCandidate.ablation: learned off; ensemble consensus off; hybrid with counterfactual; known eight starts only

learnedGuardCandidate.purpose: short scenario continuations can undervalue long-lived routes; a separate learned survival spectrum may veto those swaps
learnedGuardCandidate.gate: each model area/4096-head/tail nondecrease tolerance0.005;256/1024-head tolerance0.002; incomplete model analysis keeps original main action
learnedGuardCandidate.ablation: guarded vs unguarded cf; learned proposer and model-consensus ablations separately on known starts

developmentFeedbackRound2.reason: Initial historical-teacher critic rejected 35/39 known CF swaps, including profitable seed-2 escapes, and direct critic proposals regressed. Train with factual outcomes of the new known-start policies to expose these off-policy escape routes.
inputs: historical V11.7 stable/v116 r0 all 28 known seeds
V11_8_DEVELOPMENT: cf r0 all eight known starts
V11_8_LEARNED_DEVELOPMENT: learned r0 all eight known starts
V11_8_GUARDED_DEVELOPMENT: guarded r0 all eight known starts
developmentFeedbackRound2.unchanged: 64 features,64-32-3 ensemble,30 epochs,seed-cluster bootstrap and held-out seed split; no independent 18001+ data

trajectoryCandidate.reason: Judge the simulated future positions rather than an immediate unfamiliar afterstate; guard both overall future escape potential and paired routes that survive in both alternatives.
trajectoryCandidate.endpoint: Last processed birth state before its next policy action, or earlier actual terminal state; all16 trajectories complete; use all3 trained critics
trajectoryCandidate.longGate: Each critic separately, in each disjoint8-path bank: mean survival-area and4096-head gain>=-0.005. If>=2 paired jointly nonterminal trajectories, their mean area and4096-head gain must also>=-0.005. Terminal endpoints have zero future escape score.
trajectoryCandidate.shortGate: Existing complete-all-root CF mean gain, tail gain, mean>=1.5*paired SE and nonincreased sampled deaths, with confirmation bank and exact inherited risk protections, remain mandatory
trajectoryCandidate.incomplete: Missing model, endpoint or prediction rejects proposal; no real game RNG supplied
trajectoryCandidate.validation: Same original prespecified20unique starts,2repeats and all stability/benefit gates; no independent results seen yet

spectrumCandidate.reason: A96-step ceiling hides differences among surviving routes. Permit a long-spectrum proposal after all legal-root trajectories complete, including ceiling survivors.
spectrumCandidate.gate: Both8-path banks: short mean, bottom-quarter mean and sampled death count noninferior; all3critics long-head and survival-area gains>=0.02, area gain>=1.5*paired SE, lower-quarter endpoint-area noninferior, joint-survivor guard preserved. Original score gap<=0.003 and exact immediate death/complete risk constraints preserved.
spectrumCandidate.confirmation: Discovery bank alone nominates one direction; confirmation may reject, never reranks or picks a second direction.
spectrumCandidate.ablation: spectrum vs trajectory-only and cf; same eight known starts, final independent gates unchanged

simulationMemo.kind: decision-preserving exact per-task value reuse, separate from strategy
simulationMemo.key: packed whole-board low/high words plus identical native continuation depth; fixed native value function; bounded16384entries and discarded after each task
simulationMemo.verify: identical all completed lifetimes, merge gains, minimum spaces, final scores, endpoint states and selected actions; warmed alternating native A/B, same thread count; benchmark run alone

candidateSelectionBeforeIndependent.ranking: Prefer a candidate satisfying every mean/median/lower-quarter/early-death/score/tile gate on known starts. Then fewer failed gates; ties prefer the smallest stability regression, then greater paired mean gain. This selects exactly one candidate before fresh corpus terminal outcomes.
candidateSelectionBeforeIndependent.sampleIntegrity: This development ranking is not a strength claim; final20unique x2repeat paired gates against both comparators remain mandatory. No reselecting based on independent outcomes.

arbitratedCandidate.hypothesis: The long critic trained on factual teacher outcomes is biased when applied to cheap-policy counterfactual continuations. It successfully protects the long seed-1 route but wrongly vetoes a strong factual seed-2 escape. Permit strong paired short evidence to overrule a completed soft-model veto while preserving all hard safety/value constraints.
arbitratedCandidate.derivedGate: In EACH of two8-path banks, all usual CF gates pass; summed paired life gain>=96 (one whole horizon), bottom-quarter gain>=96/8, every paired loss bounded by96/8, sampled deaths strictly reduce. These are horizon/bank-size-derived conditions, not a new heuristic weight.
arbitratedCandidate.incomplete: Missing model/prediction or incomplete simulation never permits arbitration; exact risk, immediate mortality and original full-depth near-value constraints always retain precedence.
arbitratedCandidate.ablation: arbitrated vs trajectory without escape override, all8known starts; keep all original/spectrum/learned/guarded failures. Exactly one final candidate selected and frozen before fresh independent samples.

phasedCandidate.hypothesis: Short cheap-policy simulation can seriously undervalue mature16384+long routes. Known seed-1 strong escape overruled the joint-survivor veto at16384 and regressed17248to6908moves, while seed-2 escape at8192 gained420to7610. Retain completed model veto at rootMax>=16384; allow the exact previously declared strong escape only below that stage. This stage boundary is an empirical hypothesis, not a safety proof.
phasedCandidate.ablation: phased vs arbitrated and trajectory, all8known starts; only new stage Boolean changes; all final20unique x2repeats gates unchanged; no fresh corpus or outcomes yet

otherModeRegression.limits: two distinct known starts, all repetitions retained; no overall strength claim from this small regression set

exactComparatorCommit.reason: Use exact input/old-stable builds in final independent games, fulfilling direct V11.6 and stable comparisons; earlier known-start reports actually used frozen V11.7 engines retaining these policies and keep their original signature hashes. Numeric gates, repeats, corpus generation source and no-reselection rule unchanged. No fresh corpus or outcomes exist.
